desc:

scripts.title: OP !! Auto Buy/Auto Tower/Auto Craft
scripts.features:
🌐 Dual-Language UI (TH / EN):

Instant 1-click language switcher (🌐 TH / 🌐 EN) seamlessly translating all tabs, toggles, dropdowns, and notifications.
🌙 AFK Live Dashboard (ไก่ตัน PRO):

2D Matrix Viewer: Real-time visual tracking of Conveyor Belts, Base Slots (1–30), and Backpack Inventory with 100% authentic in-game card & pack graphics.
Zero-Lag Object Pooling: Ultra-smooth 60+ FPS performance with minimal CPU/memory footprint.
Quick Controls & Live Feeds: Direct toggle controls, currency/time counters, and real-time activity event logs.
🛒 Smart Auto-Buy & Belt Scanner:

Auto-purchases cards and packs from conveyor belts with customizable filters (Rarity, Mutation, Tier).
Automatically detects and skips Robux/DevProduct traps.
🔨 Auto Craft & Auto Open Pack:

Fully automated card crafting with recipe validation and real-time inventory checking.
Instant auto-opening for all pack types.
🔮 Trait & Rank Auto-Reroll:

Automated trait and rank reroll engines with customizable stop conditions on desired target perks.
🏰 Smart Base Manager (Slots 1–30):

Automatically analyzes multipliers and equips the best cards onto base podiums.
1-Click extraction to collect the top cards directly into your backpack.
🧪 2D Live Potion Manager:

Embedded potion viewer tracking all 4 potion types (Luck, Cash, Mutation, Production).
Selectable tiers (Tier I, II, III, or ALL), real-time stock counts, active boost timers, and auto-consumption loops.
🤝 Player Trade & Gifting System:

Target player profile card showing live avatar headshot, real-time distance, and 1-click teleport.
Multi-card selection with authentic visual previews for swift gifting and auto-trade acceptance.
Built-in trade history monitoring console.
⚔️ Tower & Boss Raid Automation:

Auto Tower: Automatically completes floors and loops replay for infinite progression.
Auto Boss Raid: Schedules and auto-joins hourly boss battles with countdown tracking.
🛡️ Security & Performance Booster:

Built-in Anti-AFK engine preventing 20-minute idle disconnects.
Built-in FPS Booster and resource optimization for 24/7 back
